### Question Title
<!-- Clear, concise question title -->
What is the difference between Nutri-Score and Eco-Score?

### Proposed Answer (Markdown)
<!-- Write the complete answer in Markdown -->
Nutri-Score measures the nutritional quality of a product (sugars, saturated fat, sodium, protein, fiber), while Eco-Score measures its environmental impact throughout its lifecycle (carbon footprint, packaging, biodiversity, transport).
